explanation: Merged main (#30, #31, #34, #32) into the query-wire branch. From this branch: queryWire.test.ts pins the published query-index names and row layouts, round-trips every row codec, checks trackEntry against the qcFlags low-power rule and proves the client reads where the generator writes; resultBars.test.tsx drops its client-only cardGlobalName pin. From main: From this branch: hypomapCodetection.test.ts runs the co-detection client against the golden services/hypomap/codetection_wire.json responses (export mismatch, contract breaks, transport failure, CSV rows), hypomapCoexpression.test.tsx covers rendered partial, unsupported, export-mismatch and Retry states, and hypomapMetrics.test.ts covers datasetMetrics/poolMetrics; the Python service test consumes the same golden. From main: expressionSurvey.test.ts, expressionSurveyLoad.test.tsx and the slimmer expressionSurveyView.test.tsx cover the survey derivation and load lifecycle, and sourceJson/teaser tests cover the shared expression-source reader.
